IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO ADDRESS PRESSING SOCIAL PROBLEMS THROUGH HIGH-IMPACT POLICY INTERVENTIONS.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE JAIN FAMILY INSTITUTE (JFI) IS AN APPLIED RESEARCH ORGANIZATION WHOSE MISSION IS TO APPLY THE INSTRUMENTS AND FRAMEWORKS OF FINANCE TO ISSUES OF GLOBAL POLICY CONCERN. WORKING TO UNDERSTAND AND COORDINATE INTERNATIONAL CHANNELS OF STATE AND PRIVATE RESOURCES, JFI APPLIES ITS DATA, MODELING, AND SIMULATION TOOLS TO THE BIGGEST CHALLENGES OF OUR TIME.
IRS990.Desc: PHENOMENAL WORLD, A FREELY AVAILABLE, TRILINGUAL PUBLICATION DEVOTED TO RIGOROUS AND INNOVATIVE WRITING ON ECONOMICS, HISTORY, FINANCE, POLICY, AND POLITICS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: FINANCING THE ENERGY TRANSITION (FETI), A RESEARCH INITIATIVE SUPPORTING GOVERNMENTS AND INVESTORS AROUND THE GLOBE WITH THE TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE, MODELING, AND FINANCIAL STRUCTURING NEEDED FOR A JUST GREEN TRANSITION.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: SOCIAL WEALTH, AN INITIATIVE HELPING GOVERNMENTS STRUCTURE AND INVEST POOLS OF PUBLIC CAPITAL IN ORDER TO PRESERVE SHARED WEALTH WHILE CATALYZING INCLUSIVE AND SUSTAINABLE ECONOMIC GROWTH.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: THE INSTITUTE'S FURTHER LEGACY PROGRAMS INCLUDE: GUARANTEED INCOME, HIGHER EDUCATION FINANCE, AI FOR THE PUBLIC GOOD & THE CENTER FOR ACTIVE STEWARDSHIP, FOCUSED ON THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE ASSET MANAGEMENT INDUSTRY AND PRIVATE SECTOR ACTION ON CLIMATE CHANGE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION IS REQUIRED TO FILE FORM 5471 BECAUSE IT MEETS THE APPLICABLE THRESHOLD OWNERSHIP OR OTHER FILING REQUIREMENTS.

GRANTMAKING REPRESENTS A SMALL PERCENTAGE OF THE ORGANIZATION'S FINANCIAL ACTIVITIES. THE GRANTS IT PROVIDES TO ORGANIZATIONS ARE GENERALLY UNRESTRICTED. THE ORGANIZATION TYPICALLY MAINTAINS A CLOSE RELATIONSHIP WITH SUCH GRANTEES COLLABORATING ON PROGRAMS, ATTENDING EVENTS OR ROUNDTABLES SUPPORTED BY THE GRANT FUNDING, AND SO ONBEFORE, DURING, AND AFTER THE FUNDS ARE PROVIDED. GRANTS TO INDIVIDUALS ARE MOST COMMONLY FELLOWSHIP AWARDS IN SUPPORT OF YOUNG SCHOLARS. IN THESE CASES, THE ORGANIZATION WORKS CLOSELY WITH NONPROFITS SPECIALIZING IN CAREER MENTORSHIP IN ORDER TO SELECT GRANTEES AMONG ITS MEMBERS.
THE ORGANIZATION IS REPORTING THE NUMBER OF CONTRIBUTORS IN PART I, COLUMN (B) OF SCHEDULE M.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART I, QUESTION 5, AND PART V, QUESTION 2A:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION CONTRACTED WITH A PROFESSIONAL EMPLOYER ORGANIZATION (PEO) FOR SERVICES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PAYROLL, TIMEKEEPING, EMPLOYEE BENEFITS, HR ADMINISTRATION AND WORKFORCE REGULATORY COMPLIANCE NEEDS. AS THE EMPLOYER OF RECORD FOR TAX PURPOSES, FORMS W-2 AND W-3 ARE ISSUED BY THE PEO AND FILED UNDER THE PEO'S FEDERAL EIN. IN THIS CO-EMPLOYMENT ARRANGEMENT, THE ORGANIZATION IS THE COMMON LAW EMPLOYER AND, ACCORDINGLY, COMPENSATION IS REPORTED ON FORM 990, PART VII, SECTION A AND PART IX, LINES 5-10.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE JAIN FAMILY INSTITUTE HAS ITS FORM 990 PREPARED BY AN OUTSIDE ACCOUNTING FIRM. IT IS REVIEWED BY THE CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER AND A COMPLETE COPY IS PROVIDED ELECTRONICALLY TO THE ORGANIZATION'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS FOR THEIR REVIEW. THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS EITHER ACKNOWLEDGES THEIR APPROVAL VIA EMAIL OR CONVENES A BOARD MEETING TO SEEK CLARIFICATION OR CORRECTION. THE CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER REQUESTS ANY SUCH CORRECTIONS FROM THE OUTSIDE ACCOUNTING FIRM PRIOR TO FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAINTAINS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY FOR EMPLOYEES, BOARD MEMBERS, COMMITTEE MEMBERS, AND KEY EMPLOYEES. COVERED INDIVIDUALS MUST ANNUALLY SIGN A STATEMENT CONFIRMING THEY HAVE READ THE POLICY AND MUST DISCLOSE ANY ROLES OR FINANCIAL INTERESTS HELD BY THEMSELVES OR THEIR FAMILY MEMBERS. THE SECRETARY REVIEWS DISCLOSURES AND REPORTS TO THE BOARD. WHEN A CONFLICT ARISES, THE INDIVIDUAL MUST DISCLOSE ALL MATERIAL FACTS, RECUSE THEMSELVES FROM DISCUSSION, AND ABSTAIN FROM VOTING. THE BOARD, USING COMPARABILITY DATA WHEN APPROPRIATE, DETERMINES IF THE TRANSACTION IS REASONABLE AND IN THE ORGANIZATION'S BEST INTEREST, AND DOCUMENTS THE PROCESS IN THE MINUTES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: IN 2022, THE ORGANIZATION COMMISSIONED A COMPENSATION STUDY FROM A HUMAN RESOURCES CONSULTING FIRM, WHO PRODUCED A SET OF RECOMMENDATIONS FROM THEIR ANALYSIS. THIS ANALYSIS COMPARED THE COMPENSATION OF A RANGE OF POSITIONS ACROSS THE ORGANIZATION AGAINST THOSE AT COMPARABLE NONPROFITS, BASED ON PUBLICLY-AVAILABLE 990 DATA AND PROPRIETARY DATA OWNED BY THE CONSULTING FIRM. THE ORGANIZATION'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS ANNUALLY APPROVES THE COMPENSATION OF OFFICERS AS PART OF THE ANNUAL BUDGET REVIEW. THE DELIBERATIONS AND DECISION ARE DOCUMENTED IN THE BOARD MINUTES. FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15B EVERY YEAR, THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS REVIEWS AND APPROVES PAY FOR ALL EMPLOYEES AS PART OF THE BUDGET PROCESS. THEIR DECISIONS ARE RECORDED IN OFFICIAL BOARD MEETING NOTES. THIS ANALYSIS COMPARED THE COMPENSATION OF A RANGE OF POSITIONS ACROSS THE ORGANIZATION AGAINST THOSE AT COMPARABLE NONPROFITS, BASED ON PUBLICLY-AVAILABLE 990 DATA AND PROPRIETARY DATA OWNED BY THE CONSULTING FIRM.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS FORM 990 AVAILABLE FOR PUBLIC INSPECTION AS REQUIRED UNDER SECTION 6104 OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE. THE RETURN IS ALSO POSTED ON GUIDESTAR.ORG AND OTHER SIMILAR TYPES OF WEBSITES. IN ADDITION, THE FORM 1023, FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION AND BY-LAWS ARE ALSO AVAILABLE UPON WRITTEN REQUEST.
